question: Which of the following events directly triggers the process of menstruation?

options.text: Non fertilisation of egg and hormonal changes
Release of sperm into the vagina

solution:
The correct answer is __**Non fertilisation of egg and hormonal changes**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Menstruation** is the periodic shedding of the **endometrium** (the inner lining of the uterus), accompanied by bleeding, which occurs in a cycle of approximately **28 days**.
 
• The process is directly triggered when the **ovum** (egg) released during **ovulation** is **not fertilized** by a **sperm**. ***Hence, statement 1 is correct.***
 
• In the absence of fertilization, the **corpus luteum** (a temporary endocrine structure) begins to degenerate. This leads to a sharp decline in the levels of **progesterone** and **estrogen** hormones.
